text:
sam: FYI supplier just sent a restrictive redistrib clause that only permits "non-commercial research" redistribution. They explicitly block embedding weights in partner images. This will impact our cloud marketplace listing and any SI-preloaded edge kits. Need legal + eng + product take.

priya: Oof. Marketplace teams need permission to list as a hosted endpoint and to publish a marketplace SKU for a hosted offering. We can still do a hosted listing without weights, but any hardware preinstall will need a redistribution addendum or an alternate flow.

hana: Product: also important for pricing and revenue share. If HW partner can't redistribute, they may ask for a different revenue split for a managed-download model. We should surface that to sales.

devon: Eng: short-term workaround is host-only serving; long-term we can support secure device pull at first-boot with signed manifests + per-device auth. That avoids pushing weights in the image but gives same UX. Requires KMS-backed signing and offline verification on device.

liam: SI partner gave us a deadline for the preloaded images by next month. If supplier refuses redistribution, SI would need to change their manufacturing flow. That's a risk for timelines.

priya: Legal, can we propose a narrow redistribution clause that lets SI preload for final-device only, with strict export control and no further redistribution? Something like:```
Limited Redistribution: Supplier grants Redwood and its specified SI partners a non-transferable, non-sublicensable right to preload the Model weights into end-user device images strictly for distribution as finished hardware products to End Users, provided that (i) redistribution is limited to the specific SI partner and Device SKU listed in Schedule A, (ii) each device activation requires authentication with Redwood-managed licensing servers, and (iii) redistribution to third parties or commercial resales beyond finished devices is prohibited without an executed Redistribution Addendum.
```

devon: That clause is promising. From infra perspective we need the manifest + checksum + signed URL workflow and a grace offline cache. We'll also add telemetry tags so we can attribute usage for revenue share.

hana: Marketing: can we still offer a co-announcement if redistribution is limited to sku-listed finished devices? Supplier wants a joint launch. We can but must be explicit in the messaging that availability depends on device SKUs and carrier/region. Also need 72h embargo notice and a supplier-approved quote.

liam: Ops: note that device firmware teams will want an offline verification step if the device is fully air-gapped. That will need pre-signed offline manifests and a device-specific key material. More complexity.

priya: Also flag: export-control + sanctions team must sign off on any per-device distribution list. I'll loop in export-control and compliance.

marketplace-bot: listing: staging model entry ml-stg-9902 created 	7 status: pending-legal-review

sam: Proposed plan: 1) @priya and @devon draft the limited redistribution clause and tech spec by EOD, 2) @hana draft comms + embargo ask for supplier, 3) @liam map SI dependencies and alternative manufacturing flows, 4) legal to validate export-control carveouts. I'll schedule a 20m sync tomorrow 11am PT with supplier.

priya: I'll draft language and include Schedule A template (SKU list). Also adding indemnity and audit rights clause to cover misuse.

devon: Starting a POC for signed-manifest on device today. I'll push a prototype to #eng-runtime and link in this thread. ETA 72 hours for prototype and a short spec.

hana: Drafting comms checklist now. Need supplier logo SVGs and an approved 2-sentence boilerplate. Prefer to have assets by Thursday to keep launch window.

liam: I'll ask SI partner if preloaded image is absolutely required or if a first-boot pull is acceptable. Will report back in 24 hours.

sam: Thanks all. Keep updates here and drop any docs or prototypes in the drive link I'll post in the 11am invite. :thumbsup:
